title: 'My Father Will Kill Me': Girl's Death Reignites Scrutiny Of Femicide In Iran
content: Sogand Sayadi, a 16-year-old girl from Iran, allegedly told friends that she feared father would kill her after learned of her romantic relationship. She died on November 14, and her father has since been arrested for her murder.  Her death has reignited criticism of Iran's lenient laws on femicide.
